description: Single classification registry for legacy identities, TypeScript ownership, persistent families, and authored destination files. Validated by `bun run eidnara:check registry migration/registry.json`. Identity classes: renamed (value leaves the tree, rename_to replaces it), frozen-durable (byte-level durable identity stays unchanged), external-protocol (wire, credential, schema, or tool-consumed identity stays unchanged), third-party. Family classes follow requirement R11. Entries seeded at U1 from commons@89abb409b8c71b03146eedb5bf64cd964f2a92c0 and magic-context@696a0fc199f9534de736bd319f8d28cdf720c332; later waves add entries as their file inventories arrive.

entries.name: kernel-store
entries.rationale: Semantic kernel store. Identity: application id, user version, marker row, incarnation id, schema-component manifest digest, exact `sqlite_schema` inventory.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id == 0x4d435458, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one mc_format_marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals fixtures/vocabulary/kernel-format-vocabulary-v1.json
entries.baseline_source: U4 composes one final baseline from the kernel schema components at the pinned magic-context commit and compares its identities to the predecessor-captured vocabulary fixture
entries.restore_policy: current-format backup and restore only; legacy-format import and every backfill path are excluded

entries.name: context-store
entries.rationale: Harness-facing context database. Written by transitional TypeScript storage until U5 moves authority to the daemon; keeps the U4 baseline and authoritative disposition through that move.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id == 0x4d435458, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one mc_format_marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals fixtures/vocabulary/direct-format-vocabulary-v1.json
entries.baseline_source: U4 final baseline; direct-format vocabulary copied verbatim from packages/plugin/src/features/magic-context/fixtures/direct-format-vocabulary-v1.json at the pinned commit
entries.restore_policy: current-format backup and restore only; reset is an explicit Doctor operation that quarantines, never a startup branch

entries.name: context-store-snapshots
entries.rationale: Backup and snapshot sidecars of `context.db`; they share its identity contract.

entries.name: module-store
entries.rationale: Module store opened by the daemon. Production opens `mc-store.db`; the `store.db` name in docs/migration-version-lanes.md is stale.
entries.probe: non-mutating open: PRAGMA application_id == 0x4d435458, PRAGMA user_version == 1, one mc_format_marker row, sqlite_schema inventory equals the captured kernel-format vocabulary
entries.baseline_source: U4 final baseline composed at the pinned magic-context commit

entries.name: artifact-cas
entries.rationale: Content-addressed artifact store. Identity is the content digest; no schema baseline beyond the on-disk layout.
entries.probe: digest of each artifact equals its address; layout version marker matches
entries.baseline_source: U4 records the CAS layout at the pinned magic-context commit
entries.restore_policy: included in current-format backup; referenced artifacts restore with the kernel store

entries.name: opencode-db
entries.rationale: Harness-owned database that Eidnara writes to but does not own (R39). No baseline, no backup or restore claim; the single-writer property applies only to Eidnara-owned families.
entries.probe: schema-compatibility probe before every write; refusal is reported as a non-failing event class

entries.name: purge-intent

entries.name: window-reports
entries.rationale: Ledger derived from authoritative state.
